author: a
scope: Separate ABBA diagnostic after timing runs; own headless Chrome process group, no forced GC. Observed sampled maxima, not an absolute peak, native-app memory or a leak test. Working-set sums can count shared pages more than once; private bytes are committed private memory, not physical resident bytes.

report.author: a
report.label: baseline-memory-r2-A1
report.scope: Own isolated headless Chrome only. No forced garbage collection. Five samples per phase. OS working set and private bytes are sums over that browser CDP process list; PIDs are not retained.
limitations: Observed phase samples are not an absolute process peak or a memory-leak test.
JS heap excludes image buffers, most native DOM memory and the desktop Python engine.
Windows process memory is unavailable on other platforms or if process queries fail.
Not native installed UI, first-install launch, physical low-end hardware or physical display latency.

retainedFailures.label: baseline-memory-A1
retainedFailures.error:
response.body: Protocol error (Network.getResponseBody): Request content was evicted from inspector cache
Response body is not available for a response that was navigated away from. Read response.body() before triggering any navigation.
retainedFailures.resolution: Large navigation response was evicted from the inspector cache before sampling. The tool now verifies bytes via its isolated request context before and after navigation. Failed record preserved; fresh filenames used.
